set.body: Deferred by user decision on 2026-08-24. Resume only on explicit product direction. Goal: remove the parallel generic motion algebra from ScalaFIM. Delete ScalaFIM RigidPose, MotionTrace, MotionSpline, acquisition-timing transform types, MotionEstimator and optimizer controls, MotionApplier and its sampling interpreter, generic MotionEstimate errors, and duplicate framewise-displacement logic. Use reframe4s-motion RigidPose with typed Moving and Fixed frame endpoints, PoseSeries, PoseTrajectory, AcquisitionSchedule, compiled rigid and multiscale series estimators, CompiledMotionApplication, and MotionMetrics directly. Decide separately whether to delete the ScalaFIM artifact entirely or retain a thin fmri-motion adapter containing only DVARS, censoring and QC policy, BIDS and NIfTI integration, TSV and report writers, CLI, benchmarks, and a neuro-specific result bundle over provider values. Do not add ScalaFIM aliases for provider motion types. Acceptance tests: 1. external JVM and Scala.js consumer compiles a ScalaFIM image through reframe4s series estimation and application; 2. existing volregger fixtures differentially verify transform polarity, identity, translations, rotations, acquisition timing, and framewise displacement; 3. retained DVARS and QC tests continue against independent or fixture oracles; 4. JVM BIDS, NIfTI, TSV, and matrix round trips preserve time coordinates, units, moving-to-fixed direction, and exact frame ownership; 5. compile-negative tests reject all deleted ScalaFIM generic motion types; 6. a mechanical gate rejects new generic motion declarations under scalafim packages; 7. full JVM and Scala.js suites plus a clean external consumer pass; 8. README, module relations, aggregate aliases, and publication metadata describe the final dependency direction ScalaFIM adapter to reframe4s-motion.
set.title: Replace ScalaFIM motion core with reframe4s-motion authority
